introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Next Football is a private, invitation-only application designed for friends to organize and track football matches. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it

scope.title: Scope and Access
scope.content: This application is exclusive to invited users only. No public access is available. All users must be invited by existing members to create an account

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.content:
We collect minimal personal data necessary to operate the application:
• First name and last name (provided during registration)
• Email address (for account authentication)
• Goal records during matches (scorer, assister, time, type)
• Game records (location, date, participants, status)
• Authentication via OAuth providers when applicable

We do NOT collect:
• IP addresses
• Cookies (beyond technical session management)
• Browser data
• Device information
• Location data
• Usage analytics

dataStorage.title: Data Storage
dataStorage.content: All data is stored securely in Supabase, a PostgreSQL-based backend service. Data is stored only for the duration your account is active and is never shared with third parties for commercial purposes

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content:
Your data is used exclusively to:
• Create and manage your account
• Track and display match statistics
• Calculate individual and team performance metrics
• Display match results and player rankings
• Enable communication within the application

security.title: Security
security.content:
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data:
• Encrypted data transmission (HTTPS/TLS)
• Secure password storage with hashing
• Role-based access control
• Regular security reviews

However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. We encourage you to use strong passwords and protect your account credentials

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content:
You have the right to:
• Access your personal data
• Request corrections to inaccurate data
• Request deletion of your account and associated data
• Withdraw from the application at any time

To exercise these rights, contact us using the information below

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated to users. Continued use of the application after such changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact the application administrator through the application's support channels
